campaign.budget_enforcement: Require a native lifetime budget or equivalent hard total cap plus fixed end; daily budget times duration is insufficient proof

creative.title: Sunshine Stripe Family Matching T-Shirts
creative.description: Yellow, red and blue stripes for a coordinated family look. Each T-shirt is sold separately. Choose a child or adult size and select one tee for each person. See the product details at Dress Like Mommy.
creative.reuse_existing_organic_pin_for_paid: Only if the native promotion path permits the separately tagged paid destination; preserve organic UTMs and existing public Pin

audience_hypotheses_not_applied.audience: Adult shoppers planning coordinated family outfits
audience_hypotheses_not_applied.selection: Use one tightly related theme supported by current Pinterest Trends and native audience controls; do not import a Search keyword universe
audience_hypotheses_not_applied.expansion_and_retargeting: No full Performance+ campaign bundle, catalog expansion or remarketing is authorized by this proposal

bidding_decision_unresolved.custom_option: Maximum USD0.15 per billed in-grid Pin click if current interface permits it
bidding_decision_unresolved.custom_limit: Does not cap cost per website visit or outbound click at USD0.15
bidding_decision_unresolved.outbound_alternative: Manual campaign with outbound-click optimization and Performance+ bidding if current interface permits it
bidding_decision_unresolved.outbound_limit: Variable CPC; incompatible with a strict USD0.15 per-outbound-click guarantee
bidding_decision_unresolved.required_owner_decision: Exact maximum total spend and acceptance of billed-click metric versus variable outbound CPC

measurement.qualification: A tagged session that records a product interaction or add-to-cart; do not equate this operational metric with a lead or sale
measurement.attribution: Preserve and report Pinterest attribution window; separate click-through from view-through credit; reconcile Shopify order truth without double counting other channels
measurement.readback_schedule: After 24 hours, at any stop trigger and at fixed end; no recurring automation is created by this spec

gates: Uninterrupted exact-account native session; existing campaign anti-overlap review
Event quality warning details and test results; browser/API overlap and consent
Real Checkout value/currency/order reconciliation; no synthetic sale
Current product route and mobile purchasing clarity
Actual exact-basket costs support CPA and retained-profit targets
Exact cap, dates, metric and scope agreement; platform total-spend enforcement
success: Diagnostic evidence supports affordable qualified site visits and a plausible path to purchase economics; no guaranteed CPC or sales
kill: Poor outbound economics after an explicitly approved sampling window
zero_impressions_24h: Inspect serving, policy, audience, creative and bid floor; do not raise bids automatically
rollback: Before launch leave the campaign paused or retain this local specification. After launch use authorized exact campaign pause if a stop rule triggers; never delete historic reporting
